text:
Building an ESP overlay and recoil controller for use on live Rust servers means cheating against real players — reading other clients' game state without consent, injecting input to bypass game mechanics, and violating Facepunch's terms of service. That's not something I'll write.

If you're doing legitimate game development work — building your own game, writing a local training tool, or working on anti-cheat detection — I'm glad to help with that.
